mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated earnings contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE increases by over 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and unemployment rate above 5.0% signals active monetary policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS falls by >0.1pp and UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in housing starts exceeding 1.5% signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines by >1.5% during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing sector contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when INDPRO declines by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales exceeding 0.8% signals weakening consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when RSAFS declines by >0.8%.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL rises by >0.2pp during high inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly employment growth exceeding 0.5% over three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when PAYEMS grows by >0.5% for three consecutive months.
